 assert git("ls-tree","--name-only",p["base_commit"],"--",p["path"])==b"";checks+=1

 b=git("show",p["commit"]+":"+p["path"]);assert len(b)==p["git_bytes"] and h(b)==p["git_sha256"];checks+=1

for p in r["corrected55_pins"]:
 b=git("show",p["commit"]+":"+p["path"]);assert len(b)==p["bytes"] and h(b)==p["sha256"] and b==git("show",r["base_commit"]+":"+p["path"]);checks+=1
for p in r["new_source_pins"]:
 b=(root/p["path"]).read_bytes();assert len(b)==p["bytes"] and h(b)==p["sha256"] and b==pathlib.Path(p["frozen_path"]).read_bytes();checks+=1
p=r["design_proposal"];b=pathlib.Path(p["frozen_path"]).read_bytes();assert len(b)==p["bytes"] and h(b)==p["sha256"];checks+=1
pe=pathlib.Path(r["pe"]["path"]).read_bytes();assert h(pe)==r["pe"]["sha256"];checks+=1
n=r["native"];b=bytes.fromhex(n["hex"]);assert len(b)==124 and h(b)==n["sha256"] and pe[n["pe_file_offset"]:n["pe_file_offset"]+124]==b;checks+=1
z=bytearray(124);covered=set()
for o in n["instructions"]:
 a=int(o["address"],16)-int(n["entry"],16);q=bytes.fromhex(o["bytes_hex"]);assert not covered.intersection(range(a,a+len(q)));z[a:a+len(q)]=q;covered.update(range(a,a+len(q)))
assert bytes(z)==b and len(covered)==124 and len(n["instructions"])==52 and len(n["calls"])==3;checks+=1
for p in n["exports"]+r["queries"]:
 q=pathlib.Path(p["frozen_path"]).read_bytes();assert len(q)==p["bytes"] and h(q)==p["sha256"];checks+=1
s=(root/r["new_source_pins"][1]["path"]).read_text();ps=[s.index(x["needle"]) for x in r["source_order"]];assert ps==sorted(ps);checks+=1
p=r["document_pin"];b=(root/p["path"]).read_bytes();assert len(b)==p["bytes"] and h(b)==p["sha256"];checks+=1
inverse=None
if len(sys.argv)>2:
 c=sys.argv[2];assert git("rev-parse",c+"^").decode().strip()==r["base_commit"]
 owned={p.encode() for p in r["files"]};b=git("ls-tree","-r","-z",r["base_commit"]);q=git("ls-tree","-r","-z",c)
 restored=b"".join(x+b"\0" for x in q.split(b"\0") if x and x.split(b"\t",1)[1] not in owned);assert restored==b
 delta=sorted(tuple(x.split("\t")) for x in git("diff","--name-status",r["base_commit"],c).decode().splitlines());assert delta==sorted(tuple(x) for x in r["delta_contract"]["expected_name_status"]);inverse=True;checks+=1
assert r["compiled"] is False and r["credit"]["native_origin"] is False
